releaseNotes: v1.2.13 Hotfix: Eliminated stamp scanner ANR/crash by moving all image decoding, resizing, and extraction onto a background Dart isolate with integer integral images + debounced Ink Clarity slider + transparency checkerboard preview + outlier trim. Added a Root Lock Curtain (Offstage) so answering phone calls or switching apps NEVER loses your half-filled invoice or open sheet upon unlock, plus a post-camera AppLockGuard handoff window so taking stamp photos never locks you out.
